observed_action: A local diagnostic command opened records.npz for train-precision-diagnostic, calibration, and test and printed only each member name, shape, and dtype. Numpy materialized members while obtaining those properties even though no values were displayed.

information_observed.calibration: Archive member names, row counts, shapes, and dtypes only.
information_observed.test: Archive member names, row counts, shapes, and dtypes only. These dimensions were already constrained by the committed split manifests and corpus schema.
information_observed.not_observed: No selected expert IDs, hidden values, logits, targets, predictions, losses, per-case results, aggregate metrics, baseline comparisons, or semantic outputs were displayed, computed, or used.

impact: The data did not influence rank selection, the already-preregistered precision thresholds, model architecture, optimizer, features, or stopping. However, the literal claim that calibration and test archives were never opened is false and must not appear in a final qualification claim.
containment: Do not access calibration or test again until the preregistered baseline and one-time-test gate. Preserve this incident and ask both persistent reviewers whether schema-only materialization requires a fresh split before a held-out claim.
current_gate: The authorized five-case train-precision-diagnostic may proceed because it was the next explicitly preregistered split; calibration/test qualification remains reviewer-gated.
